title: Learning to Interfere in Non-Orthogonal Multiple-Access Joint Source-Channel Coding
abstract: arXiv:2504.03690v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider multiple transmitters aiming to communicate their source signals (e.g., images) over a multiple access channel (MAC). Conventional communication systems minimize interference by orthogonally allocating resources (time and/or bandwidth) among users, which limits their capacity. We introduce a machine learning (ML)-aided wireless image transmission method that merges compression and channel coding using a multi-view autoencoder, which allows the transmitters to use all the available channel resources simultaneously, resulting in a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme. The receiver must recover all the images from the received superposed signal, while also associating each image with its transmitter. Traditional ML models deal with individual samples, whereas our model allows signals from different users to interfere in order to leverage gains from NOMA under limited bandwidth and power constraints. translated_title: 学习在非正交多址接入联合信源信道编码中主动利用干扰
translated_abstract: 我们考虑多个发射机通过多址接入信道（MAC）传输其源信号（例如图像）的场景。传统通信系统通过在用户之间正交分配资源（时间和/或带宽）来最小化干扰，这限制了系统容量。我们提出了一种机器学习（ML）辅助的无线图像传输方法，该方法使用多视图自编码器将压缩与信道编码融合在一起，允许发射机同时使用所有可用的信道资源，从而形成一种非正交多址接入（NOMA）方案。接收机必须从接收到的叠加信号中恢复所有图像，同时还要将每张图像与其对应的发射机关联起来。传统机器学习模型处理的是单个样本，而我们的模型允许来自不同用户的信号相互干扰，以便在有限的带宽和功率约束下充分利用NOMA带来的增益。
tldr: 提出一种基于多视图自编码器的机器学习方法，将压缩与信道编码融合，使多个发射机能够同时共享全部信道资源以实现非正交多址（NOMA）联合信源信道编码，接收端可从叠加信号中恢复所有图像并识别其对应的发射机。
en_tdlr: Proposes a machine learning-aided wireless image transmission method using a multi-view autoencoder that merges compression and channel coding, enabling multiple transmitters to simultaneously use all channel resources in a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme, where the receiver recovers all images from the superposed signal and associates each image with its transmitter.
